name: Decora Smart Wi-Fi Dimmer D26HD (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi per Leviton. The CSA listing shows Wi-Fi and Bluetooth as transports; Bluetooth is likely for setup only.

matter.note: Matter comes with a firmware update in the My Leviton app. CSA shows two listings: an older one (firmware 2.1.0, 2023) and a newer one (2.3.10, Matter 1.3, 2025).

apple_home.note: Leviton lists Apple Home (HomeKit). The optional Matter update removes the HomeKit link; re-add it with the Matter code, which needs an Apple home hub.

google_home.note: Through the My Leviton cloud link; Matter is also an option after the firmware update.

alexa.note: Through My Leviton; Matter is also an option after the firmware update.

smartthings.note: Leviton lists SmartThings and says the Matter update leaves the existing integration alone.

home_assistant.note: Through Home Assistant's Matter integration after the Matter firmware update. We found no official Leviton integration for Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: Connects straight to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and works with the My Leviton app; no hub.

localControl.note: With the Matter firmware, Matter controllers reach it on your local Wi-Fi network. Leviton doesn't state local control for its own app.

switchForm.note: Decora-style rocker dimmer that replaces a wall switch.

dimmer.note: Up to 300 W dimmable LED/CFL, 600 W incandescent, 600 VA magnetic low voltage at 120 V.

gangs.note: Not stated in the pages we saw; it is a single dimmer for one wallbox.

summary: Leviton's D26HD is a Wi-Fi dimmer in the Decora style that replaces a US wall switch and needs a neutral wire. Leviton lists Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings with no hub. A firmware update in the My Leviton app adds Matter, which is how Home Assistant reaches it. The update removes the HomeKit pairing, so you re-add it to Apple Home with the Matter code and an Apple home hub. It dims 300 W of LED or 600 W of incandescent.
caveats: Needs a neutral wire in the box.
The Matter update removes the HomeKit link; re-adding to Apple Home needs an Apple home hub.
Home Assistant needs the Matter update; there's no official Leviton integration.
An older Leviton page marked the D26HD-1BW discontinued and pointed to the D36HD; check availability before buying.
